hints.title: Minimum Element Anchor
hints.text: The smallest element in the sorted array must be the lower value of some original element.

hints.title: Candidate Difference Enumeration
hints.text: The corresponding higher value must be nums[i] with diff 2k = nums[i] - nums[0] being positive and even.

hints.title: Greedy Pairing Verification
hints.text: Test candidate differences by greedily matching each remaining smallest unpaired value x with x + 2k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N^2) pairing verification across candidate differences
complexity.notes: Smallest element nums[0] must pair with nums[0] + 2k; test candidate diffs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing arbitrary partitions without sorted pairing leads to exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array narrows candidate values of 2k to differences with nums[0].
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that nums[0] belongs to lower and pairs with nums[0] + 2k.
